title: cost-optimization-automation: defaults for batching/caching, quant profiles, and unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: reduce unit cost and operational overhead by shipping sensible defaults for batching and caching, export model quantization profiles for inference selection, and add first-pass unit-economics (uecon) tooling to make cost tradeoffs visible. This PR implements three coordinated changes: (1) Updated batching and KV-prefix caching defaults and heuristics so new tenants get throughput/cost-balanced settings out of the box; (2) Introduced reproducible quantization profile YAMLs and a runtime mapper that selects quantization/precision profiles per model family and sequence-length distribution; (3) Added unit-econ tooling including new API endpoints, CLI report generator, and Console dashboard wiring for token-level cost breakdowns and recommended config suggestions. Backwards compatibility: defaults are opt-in via a migration flag for Dedicated/Private customers; hosted tenants will receive opt-out controls. Migration guide included in docs. Performance impact: 4-12% token-cost reduction observed in benchmark lab workloads with no measurable latency regression on P99 for mid-size models; small models see improved throughput due to improved batching heuristics. Testing: unit + integration tests added for batching scheduler, quant profile selection, and uecon endpoints; added a canary rollout to validate SLOs before global merge.
